purpose: Repository-derived inventory of operator-executable production instructions. The scanner enumerates every tracked text surface; this file holds the detection rules and the minimal, justified exception register. It is not an allowlist of files to scan.

excluded_prefixes_reason..reversa/: Generated agent-context snapshots of the repository, not an operator surface. Regenerated wholesale by tooling; editing them by hand would be a lie about what the tool observed.
excluded_prefixes_reason..aiox/: Same: brownfield-discovery tool state, never executed by an operator.

inventory.prefilter_note: An optimisation only, and it must stay a superset of every rule trigger: the candidate set is every tracked text surface, and enumerateScannedFiles({prefilter:false}) returns it whole. A file is skipped only when it cannot possibly match any rule.

negation_guard.re: \b(n[ãa]o|nem|nunca|jamais|never|do not|don't|does not|doesn't|must not|may not|cannot|can't|no longer|deixou de|sem |without |not )
negation_guard.reason: A prohibition or a negative assertion that names Netlify is what this gate wants to see, not what it should report. The guard excuses a hit only when the negation sits inside the matched span, in the 90 characters before it, or in the 12 characters immediately after it (the `assert "X" not in text` shape). A negation further along the line belongs to a different clause and must not excuse anything.
negation_guard.carry_previous_line: only when the line continues the previous clause: previous line non-empty and unterminated, current line is not a new list/table/heading item nor an UPPERCASE label record, and the match starts within the first 24 characters
negation_guard.clause_boundary: The lookbehind is cut at the last sentence or semicolon boundary, so a prohibition in a previous clause cannot excuse an instruction in the next one.

exception_kinds.detector_self_reference: The gate's own module, its regression test and this rule file necessarily contain the strings the gate rejects. No content pin: these files are meant to change whenever the rules change.
exception_kinds.historical_record: A dated record of a past observation, release or decision. Its value is that it says what was true then, so rewriting it would falsify the record. Honoured only for the exact reviewed bytes (sha256); any edit re-arms the gate on that file.
